title_zh: 核对总价和取消条件后预订课程住宿

scenario.label_zh: 核对短期课程住宿并预订
scenario.goal_zh: 比较住宿总价，核对取消条款和抵达时间后确认预订

context_zh: 佩特拉准备参加短期课程，向住宿接待员丹尼尔比较两种四晚住宿方案。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Could you tell me whether the course rate includes breakfast?

sentences.speaker: Host Daniel
sentences.text: The room-only rate is fifty pounds a night. Breakfast costs an additional eight pounds each morning. Our breakfast package is fifty-five pounds a night.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Four nights with breakfast added separately would be two hundred and thirty-two pounds, then. The package would be two hundred and twenty for the same stay?

sentences.speaker: Host Daniel
sentences.text: Correct. Additionally, that package includes the evening shuttle back from the college. There are no other fees.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: That total is acceptable. Do I have to pay in advance?

sentences.speaker: Host Daniel
sentences.text: No. Payment is due upon arrival. You can cancel without a charge until noon two days before arrival; after that, the first night is charged.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: I arrive on Monday the twelfth, probably around nine in the evening. Is that too late?

sentences.speaker: Host Daniel
sentences.text: No, our reception is open until ten. Would you like the package for four nights from that Monday?

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Yes, please book it under Petra Novak. I understand the cancellation charge.

sentences.speaker: Host Daniel
sentences.text: It is booked. I will email the written confirmation with the dates, total, and cancellation terms.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Thank you. I will check the email and let you know if my arrival time changes.

targets.sense_zh: 预先，提前；用于 in advance
